name: Kaveri Meals Trust
text: Serves free lunches to daily-wage workers and bus-stand families.

name: Marina Children's Learning Centre
text: Evening classes and school supplies for children from nearby settlements.

name: Vaigai Elder Care Home
text: Residential care and medical check-ups for elders without family support.

name: Yamuna Elder Companions
text: Regular visits, errands, and hospital escorts for elders living alone.

name: Sahyadri Green Collective
text: Native tree planting and lake clean-ups with local schools.

name: Konkan Health Camps
text: Free monthly eye, dental, and diabetes screening in coastal villages.

name: Paws of Bengaluru
text: Rescues and treats injured street animals and runs sterilisation camps.

name: Ganga Women's Skills Circle
text: Tailoring and digital skills training so women can earn their own income.

name: Thar Books for All
text: Builds small village libraries in government schools.

name: Kolkata Blood Link
text: Connects hospitals needing blood with registered donors.

name: Hyderabad Anna Kitchen
text: Distributes grocery kits to families during job loss and floods.

name: Backwater Safe Home for Girls
text: Shelter and schooling for girls rescued from unsafe situations.

name: Brahmaputra River Watch
text: River clean-ups and flood preparedness training for riverside communities.

name: Sabarmati Street Dog Care
text: Daily feeding rounds and vaccination drives for street dogs.
